Definition: to slip out, i.e. escape; causatively, to deliver
BiblicalUsage: Pâlaṭ is to slip out, to escape, to deliver. The LORD is my rock and my fortress and my deliverer, God says because he has set his love upon Me I will deliver him, David is delivered from the strivings of his people, and the psalmist cries, Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe deliverance in this word is a slip through enemy fingers. God does not always stop the trap from closing, He slips His people out of it.
